messages:
casey: Heads-up: embeddings-search v2 is failing some enterprise customers with timeouts when sequence > 8k. Root cause: stray KV-cache eviction in quant path. Proposing an emergency hotfix image: redwood/emb-search:v2-hotfix-031. Need expedited deploy within 40m. Will request a non-disruptive canary ramp.
oliver: Can you own the rollout? We need clear rollback thresholds and whether routing rules change.
casey: I will own. No routing or schema changes. Rollback criteria: global error-rate increase >0.5% absolute OR p95 latency increase >300ms sustained for 4 minutes OR any canary pod OOM. Manual rollback permission: sre-oncall + pm-ops.
deploy-bot: Release request submitted for redwood/emb-search:v2-hotfix-031. Canary plan: 7% -> 25% (10m) -> 60% (5m) -> 100%. ETA start 1840012380. Excluding apac-edge by request.
sre-oncall: Oncall ack, monitoring ready. I'll trigger rollback if thresholds breach. Adding incident tag INC-184001.
pm-ops: Approving expedited. Please keep canary window visible and paste release-note text when done.
release-eng: Draft release blurb: "Fix KV-cache eviction edge-case causing timeouts for long-context embedding/search requests; no data migration required." Will publish once final link provided.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1840012380 on pool emb-search-canary-1 (7%).
casey: Quick smoke: canary nodes healthy, error-rate 0.03% in canary, p95 210ms.
oliver: Running synthetic traffic that mimics enterprise long-context queries now.
sre-oncall: Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/s/emb-search/hotfix-031. Watching errors, p95, mem.
deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 25% at 1840012430. Holding 10m verification.
casey: Observability: traces look fine, no KV churn spikes.
oliver: Synthetic suite shows stable p95 and no timeouts.
sre-oncall: Still within thresholds. No memory anomalies.
deploy-bot: Advanced to 60% at 1840012490. Hold 5m.
pm-ops: Confirm apac excluded. Noted.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 1840012500. No automated rollback executed.
casey: Deployed to prod; monitoring passive traffic. Will file a short post-deploy note and attach release notes link.
release-eng: Final release notes page: https://redwood.internal/releases/1840012345-emb-search-hotfix. I'll post to #release-notes after your summary.
pm-ops: Nice work. :thumbsup:
